$comment: MCP connectors for this project. The board's Roles x Skills x MCP matrix lives here: each seat uses a scoped set of these servers. Posture is 'scoped write' — see AGENTS.md §4.3. Uncomment and configure the servers you actually run; remove the rest. Never hard-code secrets here — use env vars or the server's own auth (oauth).

issue-tracker.$note: Used by: Product, EM, QA. Example shows Atlassian-hosted MCP; swap for Linear/GitHub-Issues MCP as needed.

docs-wiki.$note: Used by: all seats (write drafts). Confluence/Notion MCP. Promotion to canonical stays human-applied.

knowledge.$note: Used by: all seats. Local docs+code knowledge graph (pillar 5). Build it: `python3 scripts/knowledge/ingest.py --build`. This server answers scoped/federated queries + traceability (kg_query, kg_federated_query, kg_trace). Fully local — no URL or secret. Swap for a hosted KG/vector-DB MCP if you outgrow it.

context7.$note: Used by: Dev, Architect, EM. Up-to-date library/framework docs. Optional but recommended.
